Waqt apni udaan mein sabhi cheezein uda le jata hai.

Waqt koi patthar bina palte ya kchule nahi chhodta.

Waqt vyapar ka maap hai.
Waqt hamare chehron par apni vasiyat likhta hai.

Waqt zalim ke mukut ko bhi narm kar deta hai.
Bhagya ki nadi se mat lado.

Waqt wo sculptor hai jise haath nahi chahiye.
Waqt kriya hai.
Mrityu ki raat sabke liye aati hai.
Waqt anant pravah hai.
Bhootkaal peetal hai; bhavishya dhuan hai.
Waqt roshni hai.
Waqt sabhi samraaton ko ret mein badal deta hai.
Kismat hamla karne se pehle muskurati hai.
Jallad shah aur kisan dono ko leta hai.
Waqt haweli mein ek shant chor hai.
Waqt wo paani hai jo cliff ko ghis deta hai.
Jo aapke naseeb mein hai woh aapko kabhi nahi chhodega.
Ek boodha vyakti waqt ka doosri baar bacha hota hai.
Waqt abadi ka canvas hai.
Waqt sunehra gaana hai.
Kismat ko tumhe dhoondne ke liye passport nahi chahiye.
Waqt sab kuch roshni mein laata hai.
Apni kismat ko apnayo.
Bhagya aur waqt kisi ke liye intezaar nahi karte.
Waqt ka chalna nirdai aur shant hai.
Kismat tumhare dwara chuni jati hai.
Kismat hamara ekmatra lakshya hai.
Kismat antim parinaam hai.
Jawani ek chamak hai.
Zindagi ek chota safar hai.
Budhapa aisi flight jaisa hai jo toofan se guzar rahi hai.
Waqt zindagi ka khwab hai.
Jawani ek aag hai; budhapa shaant raakh hai.
Kismat ko parwah nahi ki waqt kitni tezi se chal raha hai.
Aapki kismat aapki roz ki aadato par nirbhar hai.
Jawani ek pagal sapna hai.
Devtaon dwara diye gaye ghanto ko barbaad mat karo.
Destiny aaj ke beej mein soti hai.
Bhagya insan ka malik hai, insan bhagya ka nahi.
Waqt hawa hai, kismat langar hai.
Waqt ek malik hai.
Umar buddhi hai.
Waqt chalta pyaar hai.
Waqt tamam zamini tajon se zyada jeeta hai.
Hum waqt ki kami ki shikayat karte hain, par samundar barbaad karte hain.
Waqt sabse kadwe dukh ko pighla deta hai.
Kismat hamare apne hathon se likhi jati hai.
Waqt ko behne do; kismat ko rasta pata hai.
Kismat ek maksad hai.
Apni kismat kamao.
Grace ke saath bade ho.
Bhagya ichchhuk aatma ko sone mein bandhta hai.
Mrityu se darna param shanti se darna hai.
Hum patthar par naam likhte hain, par wo mit jate hain.
Aapki kismat aapke apne haathon se likhi jaati hai.
Waqt garv ke monuments ko kha jata hai.
Sooraj sabhi samraaton par barabar dhalta hai.
Budhapa jeevan ki sham hai.
Hum dhalte sooraj ke kinare par naachte hain.
Kal ka din kisi mortal se wada nahi kiya gaya.
Kismat hasti hai jab waqt hamare pal ginta hai.
Aaj ke liye jiyo, kal ki yojna banao.
Kismat kismat ki rooh hai.
Kismat adhi raat ke khwabon mein gungunati hai.
Waqt jhoote ko nanga karta hai aur sachhe ko taj pehnata hai.
Waqt sabse mahan navacharak hai.
Hum zindagi dhoondte waqt apni qabr banate hain.
Kismat hamare safar ka lakshya hai.
Budhapa garv ki armor par laga zang hai.
Apni kismat par chalo.
Budhapa akal ka shikhar hai.
